QuestInfo.name: Formula for Your Wolf Pup
QuestInfo.0: You should ask #b#p2060000##k of #b#m230010201##k about how to raise a wolf.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2060000# tells you he's raised wolves before and promises to make #bWolf Pup Formula#k for you. In order to make the formula, you will need #b#t4000161##k, which you can get from Seacles, and #t4032331#, which is sold by #b#p2060005##k.

#i4000161# #t4000161# #b#c4000161# / 50#k
#i4032331# #t4032331# #b#c4032331# / 1#k
QuestInfo.2: Armed with all the ingredients, #p2060000# asked you to wait while she finishes making the #t4032332#.

0.0: Oh, are you raising a wolf, by any chance? I've seen plenty of people raising dogs, but wolves...not so much. Oh yes, you were asking how to raise a wolf? Well, I have had to tend to an injured wolf before, so I know a a little about raising wolves.
0.1: If the wolf pup seems weakened, that's because it's malnourished. I created a formula for wolf pups that's a bit different from the formula for huskies, and it's called #b#t4032332##k. If you want some for your pup, I'll make some for you.

yes.0: Well then, can you get me the ingredients for making the nutritious food? I'll need #b50 #t4000161#s#k, which is high in nutrients, and #b1 #t4032331##k. #p2060005#, who takes care of a variety of animals at the #m230000003# in Aqua Road, will have the necessary ingredients.
yes.1: Once you bring me all the ingredients, I'll make you some #t4032332#. See you soon.

no.0: Hmmm...you don't need any formula? So you're not actually raising a wolf, you're just researching or something...?

1.0: Oh wow, did you bring all the ingredients already? Okay then... I'm going to go ahead and make the #t4032332# right now, so talk to me in a bit.

item.0: You didn't get the ingredients for the #t4032332#? I need #b50 #t4000161#s#k and #b1 #t4032331##k. You can get #t4000161# by #bhunting the Seacle#k at Aqua Road. The vitamins are #bsold by #p2060005##k at #m230000003#.
